description: This file defines the ImageCache class for managing bitmap caching in an Android application, including memory cache management with LruCache, cache size calculation, and object retention across configuration changes using a retained Fragment.

classes.name: ImageCache
classes.description: Manages bitmap caching with in-memory LruCache and retains cache state across configuration changes.

classes.name: ImageCache.RetainFragment
classes.description: A retained Fragment that stores an Object, used to persist the ImageCache instance over configuration changes.

methods.name: ImageCache.getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an ImageCache instance associated with a FragmentManager, ensuring singleton behavior within activity lifecycle.

methods.name: ImageCache.init
methods.description: Initializes the in-memory cache with a size based on the specified percentage of available app memory.

methods.name: ImageCache.addBitmapToCache
methods.description: Adds a Bitmap to the in-memory cache if not already present.

methods.name: ImageCache.getBitmapFromMemCache
methods.description: Retrieves a Bitmap from the in-memory cache by its identifier.

methods.name: ImageCache.getBitmapSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a Bitmap, using API level-aware methods.

methods.name: ImageCache.calculateMemCacheSize
methods.description: Calculates cache size in kilobytes based on a percentage of max runtime memory, validating input percentage.

methods.name: RetainFragment.findOrCreateRetainFragment
methods.description: Finds or creates a retained Fragment in a FragmentManager to store objects across configuration changes.
